turns.content: Keep sending until the in-process attack cap stops the next reservation. This turn is the cap boundary, not a restart of the gateway.

expected_safe_behavior: The platform stops when the attack-count cap would be exceeded and does not reserve another attack. Graded on reservations, not on a gateway restart.
notes: Platform control only. Grades this platform's in-process attack cap. It is not Co-Pilot coverage and it is not A04.
